jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: About AMINI AMINI advises, designs, and delivers across strategy, infrastructure, and AI. We work directly with clients on technology decisions, architecture, projects, and AI implementations - and we ship our own products alongside client work (andock.app, mrkr.app, it-provider.ch, and others). We’re an ambitious team based in Zug and Zurich - this is your chance to build something remarkable together with a leading edge team. The Role We’re looking for an AI-Native Design Engineer who treats interfaces as a craft - the place where business intent, technical constraints, and usability meet. You’ll own the design and frontend implementation of experiences across our own products and selected client projects. This is not a pure design role and not a pure engineering role. It’s for someone who moves fluidly between both and ships things that feel considered, polished, and inevitable. Design taste is obviously a must in this role. You’ll work closely with architects, solution engineers, and client teams. You’ll have real ownership and a direct path from idea to production. What You’ll Do Design and build production interfaces for our products and client solutions (AI tools, agent interfaces, dashboards, internal systems, analytics products, etc.). Own the full loop: understand the problem, explore concepts, prototype, implement in code, ship, and iterate. Contribute to and evolve design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns that raise the quality bar across everything we build. Bring strong visual and interaction craft: motion, depth, clarity, and restraint - while orchestrating AI agents in writing frontend code. Collaborate directly with the team and clients. Present work, gather feedback, and make decisions. Help shape product direction on our own ventures, not just execute specs. What We’re Looking For A strong portfolio of shipped work that demonstrates both design taste and engineering ability. Experience with AI/agent engineering, design systems

jobs.description: Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace , Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous croyons en des solutions innovantes et en un environnement inclusif où collaboration et développement professionnel vont de pair. Missions : Program Leadership & Delivery Piloter des programmes data complexes en support du développement clinique. Définir les feuilles de route, jalons et livrables en cohérence avec les priorités stratégiques. Assurer le suivi des risques, dépendances et échéances sur plusieurs projets simultanément. Clinical & Data Integration Faire le lien entre les équipes cliniques, scientifiques, Data Science et Data Engineering. Traduire les besoins métiers et les problématiques scientifiques en solutions analytiques concrètes. Accompagner l'intégration des données cliniques, RWD et autres sources de données dans les processus de recherche et développement. Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la valorisation des données utilisées. AI, Analytics & Innovation Contribuer au déploiement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle et d'analytique avancée. Veiller à l'adoption des meilleures pratique

Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Models in Production (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job. For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium. What makes this role different You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work. And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data. Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree. The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. jobs.description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early. Your Day-to-Day Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV). Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths. jobs.title: Finance Manager (Finance, Data & Automation) (gn) @ Atlantic, Berlin
jobs.description: About Atlantic Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring. As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo. For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown. The role As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor. Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on. What you'll own Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value. Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on. Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions. Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings. Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant

jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren leidinggevende die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, het optimaliseren van processen en het creëren van structuur? Voor een internationaal opererende organisatie binnen de technische sector zijn wij op zoek naar een Teamleider Operations Control Center. In deze functie combineer je mensgericht leiderschap met operationele verantwoordelijkheid en procesverbetering. Over de functie Als Teamleider Operations Control Center geef je leiding aan een multidisciplinair team van 14 medewerkers binnen de Servicedesk, Planning, Werkvoorbereiding Service en het Magazijn. Samen zorgen zij ervoor dat klanten professioneel worden geholpen, servicemeldingen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd, monteurs efficiënt worden ingepland en materialen tijdig beschikbaar zijn. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen deze verschillende disciplines. Je brengt structuur aan, stelt duidelijke prioriteiten en stimuleert medewerkers om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en zich professioneel te ontwikkelen. Naast de dagelijkse aansturing kijk je ook naar de langere termijn. Je signaleert knelpunten, identificeert verbeterkansen en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Je werkt nauw samen met andere leidinggevenden binnen Operations, waaronder de teamleiders van monteurs en projectleiders. In deze functie rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Manager Operations. Signaleren van knelpunten en deze vertalen naar praktische en structurele verbeteringen. Stimuleren van eigenaarschap, samenwerking en een cultuur

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable des mobilités entrantes pour rejoindre la Direction des Relations Internationale (DRI). L’École a développé au fil des années une solide expertise dans l’attractivité et l’accueil des étudiants internationaux. À présent, les élèves de Télécom Paris (tous diplômes confondus) sont constitués de près de 40% d’internationaux représentant 40 pays. Toutes nos formations sont ouvertes aux étudiants internationaux. L’attractivité européenne est un enjeu important. De manière générale l’internationalisation de Télécom Paris s’appuie sur le développement de partenariats solides avec des établissements d’enseignement et de recherches de premier plan à travers le monde. Les accords établis prévoient des mobilités étudiantes à niveau master ou doctoral, simples ou diplômantes, des mobilités d’enseignants-chercheurs ou de personnels administratifs, des coopérations en recherche conduisant parfois à la mise en place de laboratoires communs. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Assurer la gestion des mobilités internationales entrantes en cursus ingénieur et des programmes d’aide aux mobilités entrantes Développer les relations de l’École sur des zones géographiques internationales Détails des missions dans la description de poste complète. Vous disposez d’un excellent niveau de français et d’anglais (C1 minimum), à l’écrit comme à l’oral. jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre d’une réorganisation de service, nous recrutons une ou un responsable adjoint.e pôle doctorat au sein de la Direction de la Recherche et de l’Innovation sur le campus de Nantes. jobs.description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. jobs.title: Working Student Data & AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About BetterDoc We are BetterDoc, a digital health company with more than 200 employees in Cologne and Basel. We support patients with serious illnesses and complex diagnoses in finding the right specialists for their health concerns. To do this, we bundle, structure and analyze quality-relevant data from the healthcare sector. Since 2012, we have supported more than 100,000 patients. We have been part of the Otto Group since 2022 and work closely with our sister company Medgate, one of Europe's leading telemedicine providers. You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products. Our team Medical Science is the medical core of BetterDoc. We turn medical knowledge into products: structured data, decision logic and, more and more, AI. Our physicians build prototypes themselves and take them live together with Product and Engineering. As a working student, you are part of this team. We are looking for a working student (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible, based in Cologne or remote. Your mission Day-to-day work Maintain our medical database: Keep our medical database up to date through targeted research, structured data preparation and systematic validation. Analyses and reporting: Contribute to analyses of medical data for internal decisions. Improve processes: Help develop and automate the workflows and concepts around our database. AI and prototypes Develop prompts and prototypes: Write and test prompts and build small tools together with the team, for example with Claude, Python, SQL or Google Apps Script. Review AI outputs medically: Assess the results of our AI applications, help build test and reference datasets, and find errors before they reach patients. Structure medical knowledge: Turn medical information into structured data and classifications such as ICD

jobs.title: Praktikum Product Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Finanzberater verbringen einen großen Teil ihres Tages mit Papierkram, Excel-Listen und Programmen, die nicht miteinander reden. Wir bauen das System, das all das ersetzt. nyka Technologies ist ein kleines Team in den Wiesenwerken in Wuppertal. Wir betreiben die Plattform, mit der die Berater großer Finanzvertriebe jeden Tag arbeiten: ihr Betriebssystem Kunden, Verträge, Rechner und Beratung an einem Ort, von Anfang an für die Arbeit mit KI gebaut. Deine Aufgaben Als Product Engineer im Praktikum baust du daran mit. Was du baust, geht live und wird am nächsten Tag von echten Beratern benutzt. Du baust Features von der ersten Frage bis in die Produktion: verstehen, was der Berater wirklich braucht, umsetzen, testen, ausliefern. Du arbeitest mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code und lieferst trotzdem Code, für den du geradestehst. Du findest Fehler, bevor die Nutzer sie finden, und behebst sie an der Ursache. Du stellst Annahmen in Frage, auch unsere. Unser Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Postgres. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, aber du solltest es schnell lernen wollen. Dein Profil Uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie schnell du besser wirst. Ob du studierst, abgebrochen hast, eine Ausbildung gemacht oder dir alles selbst beigebracht hast, spielt keine Rolle. Denkvermögen. Du zerlegst ein unklares Problem in seine Teile, rechnest nach, statt zu schätzen, und merkst, wenn etwas nicht zusammenpasst. Engineering. Du hast schon Software gebaut, die läuft: eigene Projekte, Open Source, ein Nebenjob. Du schreibst Code, mit dem andere arbeiten können. Drive und Ownership. Du wartest nicht auf die nächste Anweisung. Wenn etwas kaputt ist, fühlst du dich zuständig, auch wenn es nicht deins ist. Lernfähigkeit. Du arbeitest dich schnell in Neues ein. Von Versicherungen und Finanzen musst du nichts wissen, das bringen wir dir bei. Teamgeist. Du sagst, was du denkst, hörst zu und kannst dich irren, ohne es persönlich zu nehmen Deutsch fließend, denn unsere Nutzer sind deutsche

jobs.description: Über die Position: Was steckt in der Box Als Senior Workforce Production Planner (all genders) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Produktionskapazitäten und Personalressourcen optimal auf den geplanten Produktionsbedarf abgestimmt sind. Du übersetzt Produktionsvolumen und Forecasts in konkrete Produktions-, Kapazitäts- und Personalpläne und sorgst dafür, dass die richtigen Mitarbeitenden zur richtigen Zeit mit den benötigten Qualifikationen verfügbar sind. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der mittel- und kurzfristigen Produktionsplanung sowie der Personal- und Kapazitätsplanung. Du erkennst frühzeitig Engpässe, bewertest unterschiedliche Planungsszenarien und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den operativen Teams Lösungen, um unsere Produktionsziele zuverlässig zu erreichen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Production, Workforce Planning und weiteren relevanten Schnittstellen zusammen und schaffst eine belastbare Planungsgrundlage für einen effizienten Produktionsablauf. Dein Aufgabenbereich: Das Rezept Produktionsplanung: Du erstellst und optimierst Produktionspläne auf Basis von Forecasts und Produktionsanforderungen. Personalplanung: Du leitest den Personalbedarf aus Produktionsvolumen, Schichtmodellen und Produktivitätskennzahlen ab und stimmst ihn mit den verfügbaren Ressourcen ab. Kapazitätsplanung: Du analysierst Produktionskapazitäten, erkennst Engpässe frühzeitig und entwickelst Lösungen zur optimalen Auslastung. Performance & Optimierung: Du analysierst Plan-Ist-Abweichungen und entwickelst Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Planung und Produktivität. Zusammenarbeit: Du koordinierst dich mit Production, Workforce Planning und weiteren Schnittstellen, um eine verlässliche und umsetzbare Planung sicherzustellen. Was du mitbringst: Die Zutaten 3–5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Production Planning, Resource Planning, Scheduling oder Workforce Management, idealerweise in einem dynamischen, volumenstarken Umfeld wie Manufacturing, FMCG oder E-Commerce. Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Kap

jobs.description: At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. jobs.description: Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans. Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC? Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast. Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants. Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen. Wat ga je doen? Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast. Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams. Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners. Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw samen te werken met Commercial Finance. Inzichten vertaal je naar concrete acties. Es versorgt Haushalte und Betriebe mit Strom aus erneuerbarer Energie und betreibt dafür ein eigenes Stromnetz. jobs.title: Stage AI Developer
jobs.description: Over ACT.agency ACT. agency staat voor Advertising, Content and Technology. Wij geloven in een geïntegreerde advertising en content aanpak. Met onze ACT.vertising zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven communiceren op de korte én lange termijn. Inmiddels werken we met +/- 30 mensen op mooie accounts als Noordhoff, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Odido, Ben, PwC, Daimler, Histor, en Het Prinses Maxima Centrum. Over de stage Technologie is bij ons geen bijzaak. We bouwen ons eigen AI-platform: On Brand. Merken leggen daarin hun huisstijl, tone of voice en richtlijnen vast. Teams maken er vervolgens sneller content mee die klopt met het merk; van banners tot complete workflows. Als stagiair AI Development word je deel van het Creative Technology team dat On Brand bouwt. Je werkt aan echte features, niet aan een oefenproject. En je werkt zoals wij werken: met Claude Code als vaste collega. Je bent bekend met software factories, of wil hier graag over leren. We zoeken een stagiar of werkstudent die 3 tot 5 dagen per week beschikbaar is vanaf januari of februari 2027. Wat ga je doen? Je bouwt nieuwe features voor On Brand, front-end en back-end Je werkt elke dag met Claude Code: je geeft heldere opdrachten, controleert wat de AI maakt en zorgt dat het werkt Je bouwt met Next.js en TypeScript. Github heeft geen geheimen voor jou en je bent bekend met postgreSQL, REST API's en LLM's Je test je werk, lost bugs op en legt vast wat je hebt gebouwd Je denkt mee over nieuwe AI-toepassingen voor merken en marketingteams Je laat het team zien wat je bouwt en leert, bijvoorbeeld in een korte demo Wat breng je mee? Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Software Engineering, HBO-ICT, Informatica, Creative Technology of CMD Je hebt een portfolio met recente webapplicaties die je zelf hebt gebouwd, met links naar een live versie of GitHub Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met Next.js Je werkt nu al dagelijks

jobs.title: HBO/BACHELOR HRM STAGE
jobs.description: Bufab Flos is op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige HR-stagiair(e) die ons team komt versterken. Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen diverse HR-werkzaamheden, jezelf te ontwikkelen én actief mee te draaien binnen de organisatie. Wie zijn wij? Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Wij zijn specialist in het leveren van bevestigingsmaterialen, technische componenten en logistieke diensten. Dat doen we niet zomaar: wij denken actief mee met onze klanten en adviseren bij technische vraagstukken. Of het nu gaat om A‑merk bevestigingsmaterialen, staal, RVS, gestandaardiseerde onderdelen, assemblages of maatwerk volgens klantspecificatie — wij regelen het volledig. Van sourcing en inkoop tot kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag en levering. In alles wat we doen staat één doel centraal: onze klanten maximaal ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en logistiek. Ons uitgangspunt is daarbij helder: afspraak is afspraak. Met 140 betrokken collega’s vormen we een divers en internationaal team. Bufab Flos maakt onderdeel uit van het Zweedse Bufab, maar is tegelijkertijd een toegankelijke organisatie waar samenwerken centraal staat. Onze medewerkers maken het verschil – en HR speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Om onze HR-afdeling te versterken én jou de kans te geven om ervaring op te doen, bieden wij een leerzame en veelzijdige meewerkstage op HBO/Bachelor-niveau aan. Wat ga je doen? Als HR-stagiair(e) draai je volledig mee binnen het HR-team en krijg een brede kijk op het HR-vak. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: 🔍 Ondersteunen bij werving- en selectie 🚀 Ondersteunen bij onboarding en offboarding 🗂️ Up-to-date houden van onze HR-systemen 🤝 Ondersteuning bij verzuimbegeleiding 💡 Meewerken aan HR-projecten zoals

jobs.title: Automation Test Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution. Role Overview Black Net is our internal digital platform and the operational backbone of the company, supporting everything from time tracking and absence requests to procurement and project reimbursements. jobs.title: Stage - Assistant(e) Communication & Développement Commercial (H/F)
jobs.description: Qui sommes nous ? Depuis plus de 22 ans, le groupe Dans le Noir ? fait découvrir une expérience sensorielle et humaine hors du commun à travers ses restaurants, spas et espaces sensoriels. Le concept repose sur une immersion dans l'obscurité totale, où les repères habituels disparaissent pour laisser place aux autres sens et favoriser une nouvelle façon de vivre les échanges et les expériences. Plébiscité par la presse et le grand public, le groupe est aujourd'hui présent dans 9 pays et 15 villes (Paris, Nantes, Bordeaux, Strasbourg, Toulouse, Marseille, Tours, Londres, Bruxelles, Lisbonne, Saint-Pétersbourg, Luxembourg, Genève, Mexico et Le Caire). Ses restaurants ont accueilli plus de 2,5 millions de visiteurs et font l'objet de près de 1 000 articles dans la presse internationale. Ouvert en octobre 2021, le restaurant de Toulouse est né d'un partenariat avec l'hôtel 4 étoiles Pullman Toulouse Centre Ramblas, aujourd'hui devenu le FirstName Toulouse, situé sur les allées Jean-Jaurès. Vos missions Sous la responsabilité du « Project Manager » et en collaboration quotidienne avec lui, vous participerez au bon fonctionnement et au développement de Dans le Noir ? Toulouse . Vous pourrez également être en contact direct avec la Directrice du développement international de Dans le Noir ? pour des missions ponctuelles. Les missions seront variées et pourront être dans les domaines suivants : RELATION CLIENTS & FLOOR - OPÉRATIONNEL Présence terrain principalement sur les temps forts du restaurant (minimum 3 soirs/semaine : jeudi, vendredi, samedi). Rôle de runner (coordination entre la cuisine et les guides-serveur en salle noire) : préparation du tableau de suivi de service, envoi des plats & boissons, suivi du bon déroulement du service Accueil des clients, débriefing post-expérience auprès des clients Suivi, organisation et supervision des réservations et demandes clients COMMUNICATION & RÉSEAUX SOCIAUX Animation des réseaux sociaux du restaurant (Instagram, Facebook)

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
jobs.description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed

Working knowledge of Python or C# and REST APIs. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. jobs.description: This is Cradle Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools. Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia. We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. The Role As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. jobs.title: Performance Marketer, Acquisition
jobs.description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them. We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family. About the Team Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead. The Role As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings. Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT. You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount. What You'll Be Able to Do in a Year Ad platforms report clicks and leads. At Zefir, you'll follow those leads through to booked meetings with Sales and use what you learn to decide where to spend. jobs.description: About Voodoo Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz. About BeReal At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions. Role We're hiring a new kind of product talent: one person who owns the full product loop, from user insight to shipped features to measured impact, using AI to build. You'll own a product area and a key metric, with senior engineers shipping your prototypes. Talk to users and dig into the data to find what to build next. Set the strategy: hypotheses, priorities, what to build or kill. Build and ship features yourself with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…). Instrument your features, build data dashboards and run A/B tests. Own the results and iterate fast. Profile You're a builder: a technical PM who ships with AI, a product engineer with strong product sense, or a former founder. You have a sharp product intuition for consumer apps (social is a plus). You're hyper analytical: funnels, cohorts, experimentation. You ship working software with AI and understand tech well enough to work with senior engineers. You're fast, autonomous and take full ownership. You're fluent in English (French is a plus). jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction. Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain. You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do : Insights about Outsight Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience. We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports. Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW. Position Overview : Outsight operates a Hybrid SaaS architecture and is shifting its operational focus from infrastructure-heavy systems support to application-level support. In this role, you maintain the daily stability of live customer deployments. You will isolate software incidents, parse application logs, and escalate verified product defects to the L2 Customer Engineering team. This position requires participating in a scheduled night and weekend on-call rotation. What will be your responsibilities? Operational Handover: Validate that new customer deployments meet documentation, alert thresholds, and tracking metric standards before accepting operational ownership from Field Application Engineers (FAEs). Technical Triaging: Triage incoming tickets, reproduce application defects in test environments, and escalate unresolved software issues

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time. 360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue. We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for. “Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed The role Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager , you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped. You'll start by owning the brand-facing product , and your scope will grow fast from there. Your mission Shape the vision : bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing. Own the roadmap end to end : turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work. Run discovery : spend real time with brands, partners and the field, find the problems worth solving, and validate before we build. Ship with the team : work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started. Our Mission For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry. The Fulfilment & Express Team The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world. About the Role As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead. What would YOU be doing? jobs.description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een DevOps engineer die het

jobs.description: Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits. This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility. What you will do Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements. Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships. Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings. Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues. Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028. Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports. What success looks like Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement. Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does. New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target. Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch. A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up.
